Sky-Watcher Evostar 102

The classic 4-inch achromatic refractor — sharp, simple, honest.

around $280

A 102mm f/10 achromatic refractor: long tube, rack-and-pinion focuser, zero collimation ever. The old-school refractor that shows razor-sharp Moon and planets and doubles as a spotting scope by day.

Why we like it

  • Refractor — never needs collimation
  • Superb lunar and planetary sharpness for the money
  • Doubles as a daytime spotting scope

Keep in mind

  • Optical tube only — needs a mount and tripod
  • Achromatic design shows false color on bright objects
  • Long tube is awkward to store and transport
